evals.prompt: Refresh this research repository. The mathbox plugin already provides proof-audit and research-attempt, but the repository also has local copies under .agents/skills and two more under a root skills directory.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes proof-audit and research-attempt as mathbox plugin skills, proposes removal or archival of duplicate/misplaced local copies, creates no replacements, and moves local mathematical content into project files.
assertions: Defaults to no project skills
Flags root skills as misplaced
Does not regenerate mathbox plugin skills
Presents a proposal before writing

evals.prompt: Set up this mathematical research repository so agents can retain public papers locally without committing them and can avoid indexing copyrighted cache contents during repository inspection.
evals.expected_output: Proposes the standard .research-cache/literature convention, a tracked root ignore rule, an explicit retention policy, and leaves cached source content outside repository inspection and tracked research records.
assertions: Proposes /.research-cache/ in the project Git ignore rules
Treats the cache's own internal ignore rule as a fallback, not as the project rule
Records only metadata and hashes in the tracked literature ledger
Does not inspect or commit cached PDF or extracted-text content
Makes source retention conditional on project authorization

evals.prompt: Initialize this repository and determine whether every theorem cited in its literature ledger has the hypotheses needed by the proofs.
evals.expected_output: Inventories and configures the repository first, then executes the explicitly requested substantive theorem checks as a subsequent literature-check work package within the same assignment.
assertions: Keeps repository initialization separate from source verification
Does not read cached source content merely to initialize the repository
Routes substantive theorem questions to literature-check
Completes authorized source checks or reports actual source-access limits rather than merely deferring them

evals.prompt: Refresh this Git-backed research repository. RESEARCH_LOG.md contains several long-form route entries, one has no date, and a preamble does not belong to any entry. Convert it to the current research-record architecture.
evals.expected_output: Makes a concrete lossless migration mapping, classifies relevance against the repository mission, preserves unmatched or uncertain context in quarantine, and requires review of the mapping before replacing or indexing the legacy log.
assertions: Triggers on route-level prose rather than a size threshold
Shows source spans, destinations, relevance classifications and carried evidence labels for review before indexing
Uses the earliest supporting Git date for the undated entry and labels that date as inferred
Preserves unmatched, foreign and ambiguous text in quarantine rather than live project history
Verifies lossless representation before replacing RESEARCH_LOG.md
Does not strengthen legacy evidence labels or statuses

evals.prompt: Retrofit this project now, preserving historical records. Several confident proved labels have no accessible proof artifacts. Add executable claim tracking if useful.
evals.expected_output: Applies existing edit authorization, maps exact claims conservatively and does not import unsupported prose as proof.
assertions: Does not ask again for routine authorized changes
Retains historical content and claim IDs
Separates proof artifacts from status labels

evals.prompt: Inspect and propose a retrofit for this synthetic-style repository. It uses PLAN.md, STATUS.md, two dated HANDOFF files, THEOREMS.md, FACT_INVENTORY.md, docs/path-migrations.json, and computation manifests under checks/. AGENTS.md exists but CLAUDE.md does not; RESEARCH_LOG.md mixes linked index lines with full route prose.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes semantic role aliases rather than requiring canonical names, inventories computation manifests and path maps separately, accepts AGENTS.md without a CLAUDE.md bridge and reports multiple handoff candidates, classifies the log as mixed without choosing authority from filenames alone, and leaves source-derived inventory assertions pending verification.
assertions: Recognizes plan, status, theorem/fact inventory and handoff variants
Inventories computation manifests separately from build manifests
Does not require a CLAUDE.md bridge when AGENTS.md is present
Flags multiple handoff candidates for authority review
Classifies the research log structurally as mixed
Schedules exact source verification before source-derived inventory entries become foundations
Reports misplaced root skills and the log classification from the default brief inspection

evals.prompt: Retrofit the research history. The legacy log contains one route about the stated mission, one record clearly copied from a different project, and one whose relevance cannot be determined from the text.
evals.expected_output: Prepares a lossless reviewed mapping, proposes normal records only for mission-relevant routes, quarantines foreign and ambiguous material with provenance, and does not index it as current project history before review.
assertions: Classifies relevance against the explicit repository mission
Does not infer relevance from topic words or filenames
Quarantines foreign and ambiguous records without declaring them mathematically false
Requires mapping review before replacing the live index

evals.prompt: Initialize this repository for a journal manuscript. The draft is 24 pages, but I have not told you the venue, language, audience, deadline, page-count rules, or page budget.
evals.expected_output: Treats every submission constraint as unresolved and asks a compact material interview covering venue/template/category, language/audience, exact deadline, count convention, and a page budget that includes front matter, bibliography, figures and contingency.
assertions: Does not infer a page limit or venue from the current draft
Asks for language and intended audience
Asks for an exact deadline and timezone
Asks what the page-count convention includes
Requires explicit budget for front matter, main text, bibliography, figures/tables, appendices/supplement and contingency

evals.prompt: Refresh this research repository's agent architecture. The current status is a long sequence of dated checkpoints, AGENTS.md repeats the current deliverable, and a preserved import directory contains hundreds of links that are broken only in that historical location.
evals.expected_output: Produces a reviewed plan for one compact current dashboard, leaves durable history linked and discoverable, moves mutable deliverable facts to the charter/status, and separates current-path inspection findings from historical candidates before proposing edits.
assertions: Uses the brief inspector first and drills into omitted current-path findings
Does not treat historical import links as automatically live broken references
Keeps project-specific authorization and mathematical safeguards in root instructions
Preserves old checkpoint evidence before replacing live-status narratives
Does not require reading the whole growing status file in every future task

evals.prompt: Plan the migration of this existing research repository to compact instructions and one live status. Its AGENTS.md requires reading a 150 KB status file; dated checkpoints mix current and historical claims; its schema-v1 ledger has pre-existing stale issues and a charter pinned by many active claims. Do not edit yet.
evals.expected_output: Produces a read-only section inventory, proposed source-to-destination crosswalk and baseline, marks uninspected ranges, identifies authority conflicts and pin fanout, and stops before editing or refreshing hashes.
assertions: Treats the request as a plan, not authorization to edit
Uses brief inspector and ledger queries before targeted detail
Plans complete accounting for substantive old status sections and unique AGENTS rules before replacement
Does not move mutable facts into the pinned charter merely to match a template
Distinguishes pre-existing ledger issues from migration regressions
Captures the complete baseline issue list rather than the eight-issue summary sample
Does not rewrite schema-v1 events or infer proved from historical prose

evals.prompt: Retrofit this research repository's history now. Its RESEARCH_LOG.md is a large flat index with working relative links, several long-running programs and one route of uncertain provenance. Keep ordinary route records immutable and make routine navigation compact.
evals.expected_output: Builds a reviewed route-to-program mapping, preserves the old flat index and links, creates a small designated program/phase entry point with closeouts and route indexes, leaves the uncertain route unpromoted, and verifies link reachability before replacement.
assertions: Does not infer program membership from filenames or dates alone
Keeps old index text reachable, preferably as a frozen legacy index
Does not duplicate all route lines in the new top-level entry point
Does not turn uncertain historical material into a current program result
Checks links and source-to-destination coverage before replacing the live entry point
Treats broken links inside current route records as current findings, not archived history

evals.prompt: Migrate a 2023 flat research log into program indexes. A theorem was proved only in a 2025 revision; the 2023 program cutoff is inferred from Git history, and two mission-relevant route entries have no defensible program assignment. Preserve all old links.
evals.expected_output: Builds retrospective closeouts that label the 2023 cutoff as inferred and distinguish the 2025 assessment, preserves the two routes in a linked unclassified inventory, reconciles every old entry to a program, unclassified inventory, or quarantine, and retains the old index and working links.
assertions: Does not turn first Git appearance into a certain mathematical completion date
Does not backdate the 2025 proof to a 2023 closeout
Keeps mission-relevant but unassigned routes linked and outside program verdicts
Uses quarantine only for foreign or mission-ambiguous material
Accounts for all old entries and verifies links before changing the default entry point

evals.prompt: Set up root agent instructions for a small research repository that will not have a separate charter file. The owner wants agents to follow their current direction.
evals.expected_output: States the main question, deliverable, success criterion, fallback, and exclusions in AGENTS.md; lets current user direction set scope and priorities without ranking it above durable proof on mathematical status; and requires fresh adversarial review before a material new claim is promoted.
assertions: Records mission, success, fallback, and exclusions somewhere durable rather than deleting the charter pointer
Keeps durable proof above chat or user assertion for mathematical status
Requires fresh adversarial review before promoting a material new claim
Replaces every template placeholder
